newsitem.title: USA: Sabratek 1996 loss due to $1.6 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: Sabratek 1996 loss due to $1.6 mln charge.

text.p: Sabratek Corp said Tuesday its net loss for 1996 included a $1.6 million non-recurring charge for stock appreciation rights.
Without the charge, Sabratek said, it would have posted net income of $770,000 or $0.11 a share.
Earlier, it reported a net loss for the year of $858,000 or $0.12 a share. For 1995, it had a net loss of $6.0 million or $0.90 a share.
For the fourth quarter, it had earnings of $477,000 or $0.05 a share on sales of $6.1 million, compared with a year-ago loss of $1,590,000 or $0.24 a share on sales of $1,406,000.
The company said its quarterly results mark its fourth consecutive quarter of record sales and operating profitability and its second quarter of net profitability.
Sabratek develops and markets interactive therapeutic and diagnostic medical systems for the alternate-site health care market.
